note: USACE Saylorville Lake, on the west side, on 26 acres of upland timber. The electric loop sits in woods well back from the lake (about 200 m of forest and a drop to the shore from the nearest sites). Site 3 has a small pond beside it. Shorter pads: sites 7 (22 ft), 18 (19 ft) and 23 (20 ft). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $24 (added $26 high), 50 amp, facilities, no walk-ups, 14-night limit, senior pass. Count now 29 family sites. Season not stated; rate tables and calendar read only as bookings through Oct 14. Pond lead for site 3.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (pond, up, small): rec.gov per-site plot on imagery and the official photo of site 003 show that pad about 15 m of open mowed grass from a pond's north shore, no road between. Sites 001 and 002 are close to the pond's west arm, but their official photos show no water. Pond measured off imagery at about 140 x 25 m, roughly 0.9 acre, so it is a pond by AWH's rule. That is 1 of 29 RV sites, perhaps 2. Saylorville Lake itself: stored not waterfront stands; the nearest sites (12-14) are about 200 m through forest from the shore, no view in the official photo of site 013, no per-site water tag on rec.gov.
FIT: 3 of the 29 are capped under 23 ft on rec.gov (007 at 22 ft, 018 at 19 ft, 023 at 20 ft); 24 bookable sites fit a 23-ft motorhome. Sites 028 and 029 are not reservable (status Not Available).

PIN: stored is about 100 m from the centre of the 29 sites (41.7380,-93.7205); fine. Phone 515-276-0429 matches rec.gov. USACE district page refused plain HTTP (403), so it stayed unread; Saylorville pages not checked for closures. rec.gov lists no closure notice.
